import sys, os

# Verify CSV exists and has expected columns
if os.path.exists('materials_thermal_dataset.csv'):
    import pandas as pd

    print('Missing targets:', missing)
else:
    print('Dataset file not found (expected if Phase1 not run — OK)')
print('Smoke complete.')
